title: backlog.py cost dates an item by a done commit that only an unlanded branch or ref holds
goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-ot6xthfk: bl_cost.item_done_time runs git log --all and now takes max(), so the newest done commit on any ref wins (a work/<id> branch, a ref a failed land kept after done --commit, a fetched code/<id>, a stash); an item done on main, reopened, and done again only on such a ref is dated by the unlanded done and cost_no_line may name a likely cause for an item main says is doing. item_done_time reads only the history of the integration main (or HEAD), the repro exits 0, and backlog.md's Cost of work says which history it reads.

run: import os,sys,json,subprocess,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_cost as b;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a,**e:subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(t),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,env={**os.environ,**e});g('init','-q','-b','main');g('config','user.email','a@example.com');g('config','user.name','a');f=t/b.REL_DIR/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.parent.mkdir(parents=True);w=lambda s,d:(f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':s},indent=2)),g('add','-A'),g('commit','-qm',s,GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=d,GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=d));w('doing','2026-01-01T00:00:00Z');w('done','2026-01-03T00:00:00Z');w('doing','2026-02-01T00:00:00Z');g('checkout','-q','-b','work/ST-aaaaaaaa');w('done','2026-03-01T00:00:00Z');g('checkout','-q','main');r=b.item_done_time(t,'ST-aaaaaaaa');print('done time of a reopened item whose second done is only on a work branch:',b.epoch_iso(r) if r else r);sys.exit(0 if r and b.epoch_iso(r).startswith('2026-01-03') else 1)
